chapter: Brass bands: Eureka and Henry Allen
title: Eureka band members and the arrival of saxophones
summary: He names Eureka members who died and were replaced, including trombonists and a drummer, and recalls clarinet before saxophone.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Do you remember some of the other fellas that were in the Eureka when you...
John Kazmi. He was in the Eureka. There was Jimmy.
Jimmy was that the drummer?

The drummer. Jimmy, they had a big fella, he died. He was playing a funeral across the road there. He used to play the tour. He died. He got sick and died. I believe he died on the way. I think he did. He told me it was coming from one of the other sides of Gretchen. Yeah. I never knew it.
It wasn't Eddie Jackson. No, it wasn't Eddie Jackson.
You don't use these, do you? No, I think about it.
There was Red Clark in the band when you were there. Who? Red Clark, Joseph Clark. He played trombone. He played trombone one time.
Connish. I know Connish was playing trombone. And Connish was playing trombone. And they had another fella play trombone with Connish. But he died.
Yes.
I just forgot his name. But he died. And then we got Warner. Oh, yes. After they got Warner. And then Connish died and we got Red.
Oh, yes. I see.
And after they got Red, and Willie, Johnny, Willie died. Willie died first. That's the leader.
Yes.

And Johnny's brother, he was playing the baritone. He died afterwards. And then Connish, he died. Well, most of them, most of them, most of them, yes. And there were fellas playing alto, he died. Yeah, a fella played alto, I call him Buddy. He used to, the name Buddy, he used to work at the, at the, this, this clothing place right there, right on Connell Street there. What's he called? A clothing place? Yeah, he used to work, he used to work there. Oh, oh, wow. What'd you call that? Big clothing store. Yeah, on that side, on Connell Street. I don't know, there's Stine.
Joyce. Oh, Joyce, I don't know.
Yeah, yeah. Well, he didn't name Buddy, he used to play alto.
Did they have any saxophones in the band then?

They didn't have no saxophones in the band then. We were using clarinet. Who was the clarinet player? John Cassidy. Oh, that's right, you told us. Yeah. And then afterwards, we started to use in the sax. Yeah. And the fellow we started using sax with, he's up there in town, he's a barber uptown there now. He started to say, I don't know, forgot his name. A barber uptown?
Yeah.
Yeah.
I guess a lot of musicians from barbers, they said. Yeah.
We'd never know it.
